purpose: Apply unchanged Gaia DR3 association and stellar guard to the exact104 metadata temporal/quality-pass extension candidates. Original188 and feasibility940/8277 remain unchanged. No flux request or analysis.

gaia_query.truncation_rule: TOP/MAXREC50000; if returned count>=50000 or bytes>=8000000, terminal stop. No alternate cone/catalog/field.
gaia_query.retry: One identical request only HTTP500/502/503/504, timeout, connection reset/aborted/broken-pipe, including URLError wrapping exactly those exceptions. All denial/redirect/other errors terminal. Unknown bytes charged full8MB reservation.
gaia_query.coordinate_validation: Valid finite RA[0,360),Dec[-90,90] and recomputed separation<=3960.001arcsec.

association.target_epoch: Each Rubin midpointMjdTai convertedTAI->TCB Julianyear. Rubin object coordinates are assumed representative of contemporaneous astrometry; precise object reference epoch absent, recorded limitation.
association.propagation: Gaia ICRS positions and proper motions from ref_epoch; astropy spherical apply_space_motion; finite positive parallax supplies distance, finiteRV or zeroRV; noPM catalog positions retained as uncertainty neighbors but cannot qualify as sole match.
association.unique_rule: Exactly1 Gaia source within1arcsec and exactly1 within2arcsec, with finitePM for matching source. All neighbor solutions including noPM enter ambiguity check.
association.field_margin: Gaia cone1.1deg around Rubin1deg field leaves0.1deg=360arcsec reference-epoch margin; completeness conditional on unmodelled motion within margin.

stellar_evidence.pm_metric: sqrt(mu.T inverse(C_pm) mu), finite positivePMerrors and validcorrelation; otherwise unavailable.
stellar_evidence.rule: parallaxSNR>=3 ORPMjointSigma>=5. No nearest-only association called stellar proof.
stellar_evidence.quality_flags: ruwe,duplicated_source,astrometric_params_solved retained descriptively; no posthoc threshold tuning

prior_exclusion.gaia_ids: Union original all433 Gaia neighbors within2arcsec, original188 selectedGaiaIDs, historicalDEV annotations, and recomputed prior433 neighbors within2arcsec using this same1.1degree catalog. Recomputed prior433 context is exclusion-only and never modifies original cohort.
prior_exclusion.duplicate_extension_gaia: Keep smallest exact numeric DiaObjectID among otherwise eligible candidates.

sort: Same original reliable-positive-parallax distance ranking1000/parallax pc withparallaxSNR>=3 ascending then exactnumericDiaObjectID; PM-only/uncertain distance last byID. No flux/anomaly sorting.
unchanged_original_scientific_implementa: match_gaia.py copied from original; coordinate propagation, neighbor guards, stellar metrics and distance ordering unchanged. Adapted pool/output paths/dimensions, catalog field dimension and additional prior-cohort exclusions only.
limitations: Alert-selected bounded cone/time sample, not allstars or allsky.
Association and stellar-evidence selection does not establish>=50 photometrically evaluable objects.
Missing or ambiguous motion/neighbor evidence remains explicit rejection.
Gaia parallax distance is only rankingproxy, no inference ofunbiased distanceposterior orzero-pointcorrected distance.
104 candidates were prefiltered only by fixed metadata temporal/quality prerequisites; this is a separate extension cohort, not a revision of initial188.
All metadata source withdrawal statuses were unknown and remain mandatory quality caveats under the original method.
independent_preflight: Required PASS with exact plan_sha256, acquire_script_sha256 and match_script_sha256 before request.
